links.outcome: Downstream AI performance after applying facial de-identification (defacing) methods to imaging datasets
links.effect: QuickShear reduced mean Dice by up to 9% with 14-19% QC failure rates. PyDeface caused smaller losses. mri_reface had 100% success and stayed within 3-5% of original accuracy.
links.quote: Invasive algorithms caused significant degradation across all tasks.

unlisted_practices: Preferring facial-replacement anonymization (mri_reface) over invasive defacing for shared imaging datasets
Transparent reporting of anonymization pipelines and quantitative privacy-utility assessment for shared imaging data

screen.reason: The study directly evaluates the downstream performance impact of data privacy/anonymization safeguards (facial defacing algorithms) on AI model diagnostic reasoning, segmentation, and report generation.
